description: Convert a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP or TIFF into one multi-size .ico (16 to 256 px), padding or cropping non-square images. AVIF, HEIC and SVG are not accepted here. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

fit.description: How a non-square image becomes a square icon: pad keeps the whole picture and fills the sides with transparency; crop fills the square from the centre and cuts the long side. Square images are unaffected.

name.description: The source filename. The icon keeps its stem: logo.png becomes logo.ico.

sizes.description: Pixel sizes to pack into the one .ico file, from 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256. Defaults to 16, 32, 48 and 256, which covers browser tabs, the Windows taskbar and Explorer.

type.description: The MIME type of the source image: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif (first frame), image/bmp or image/tiff. SVG, AVIF and HEIC are not accepted here.

name: png_to_ico
title: PNG to ICO Converter
